title: Corner Detection
text: 计算角点度量矩阵并在图像中查找角点，输入 1 路、输出 3 路；按 {Output} 指定模块输出 Corner；{Method} 指定角点检测方法 Harris corner、{Sensitivity factor (0<k<0.25)} 指定敏感度因子、{Coefficients for separable smoothing filter} 指定滤波器系数 fspecial、{Intensity comparison threshold} 指定强度阈值、{Maximum angle to be considered a corner (in degrees)} 指定最大角点角度、{Maximum number of corners} 指定最大角点数量、{Minimum metric value that indicates a corner} 指定最小角点度量值、{Neighborhood size} 指定邻域大小、{Output variable size signal} 指定可变大小信号、{Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} 指定数据类型覆盖，按实例取值。

ports.name: I
ports.summary: 输入图像 matrix of intensity values

ports.name: Count
ports.summary: 检测到的角点数量 scalar

params.name: Method
params.values: 角点检测方法 Harris corner detection (Harris & Stephens) (default) | Minimum eigenvalue (Shi & Tomasi) | Local intensity comparison (Rosten & Drummond)

params.name: Maximum angle to be considered a corner (in degrees)
Output
params.values: 模块输出 Corner location (default) | Corner location and metric matrix | Metric matrix

params.name: Minimum metric value that indicates a corner
Output variable size signal
params.values: 可变大小信号 on (default) | off

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 数据类型覆盖 off (default) | on
